subject: Renewal + Expansion: pricing step-ups, blended rates, new model routes
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@stellar-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-01T16:20:00Z
Subject: RE: Discovery recap & next steps (model routes + pricing)

Hi Alex, thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps: 

What I heard: 
- Primary use case: customer support triage + sentiment routing across Channels A (chat) + B (email).
- Expected monthly consumption ranges: 20M-60M tokens/month in year 1, with spikes during promotions.
- Interest in adding two new model routes (smaller NLU model for intent classification + larger response-gen model) during renewal.
- Procurement timeline: target signature by end of Q2.

Proposed next steps: 
1) You to confirm expected committed baseline (monthly tokens) and target $/1M tokens range you're budgeting for.
2) I'll share a consumption estimate and a pricing step-up proposal (blended rates for mixed routes/models) - see attachment.
3) If numbers look good, we'll draft a renewal amendment with step-up tiers and add-on routes.

Attachments: consumption-estimate-stellar.xlsx (spreadsheet) - rough volumes and model route split.

Budget/qualification question: can you share the ballpark target unit economics you're aiming for ($ per 1M tokens) across baseline and expansion? If you can give a short range (e.g., $300-600 / 1M tokens) that helps me build blended tiers that meet your procurement expectations.

Thanks. I'll follow up with a formal tiered proposal by EOD Friday.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@stellar-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-02T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps (model routes + pricing)

Thanks Marissa, appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Baseline: we expect to commit to ~25M tokens/month to start, with a planned step-up to 50M after 3 months and 75M by month 9 if accuracy holds.
- Route split: 60% NLU (classification/intent), 40% response gen. The NLU route should use a smaller, cheaper model; response-gen will use the larger model.
- Budget: our procurement lead is targeting a blended unit economics target of roughly $250-350 / 1M tokens avg across blended routes for the first contract year. Upper bound if needed for exec signoff is $500 / 1M.
- Procurement ask: if you can provide a three-tier step-up pricing schedule (25M baseline, 50M mid, 75M expansion), plus blended rates that reflect the route/model mix, that would be ideal. We may also add an ad-hoc 'experimental' route later (different model) - please include optional pricing for adding a new route.

I'm looping in Procurement (procurement@stellar-retail.com) for visibility. We'll review your proposal and get a PO draft ready if we can agree on unit economics.

Cheers,
Alex
Director, Product 
Stellar Retail

> On Mar 1, 2027, at 16:20, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> [See above]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@stellar-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-04T15:00:00Z
Subject: RE: Renewal pricing proposal (step-ups + blended rates) - draft attached

Alex, thanks for the specifics, super helpful. Attached is a draft pricing proposal and a consumption worksheet with blended math. High-level summary below and a few callouts: 

Attachments: pricing-stepups-proposal.pdf (PDF), consumption-estimate-stellar.xlsx (spreadsheet)

High-level proposal: 
- Baseline (25M tokens/mo): blended rate $420 / 1M tokens (reflects 60/40 split; NLU route at $200 / 1M, response-gen route at $700 / 1M).
- Mid step (50M tokens/mo): blended rate $350 / 1M tokens.
- Expansion (75M tokens/mo): blended rate $300 / 1M tokens.
- Optional add-on route (experimental model): $600 / 1M tokens when added; blended math updated pro rata.
- Volume step-up discounts apply at invoice milestones; we can do quarterly true-ups.

Why these numbers: we used per-route unit economics that map to your route split and applied blended weighting plus a recommend quantization profile for NLU to lower cost. This gets us in the ballpark of your $250-350 target at mid/expand tiers while preserving quality on response generation.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Let me know any redlines to the step-up tiers or the optional route price.
2) If OK, I'll send a renewal amendment with the tier table and blended-rate formula for procurement to review; Ben can help scope any enterprise discounting.
3) We can lock a 90-day pilot pricing for the first step-up to validate cost/quality.

Quick ask for procurement: if you can share any internal PO templates or specific legal procurement constraints, we'll include them in the amendment.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---Quoted text---
On Mar 2, 2027, at 10:05, Alex Johnson <alex.j@stellar-retail.com> wrote:
> Thanks Marissa, appreciate the clear recap...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Kim <david@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-05T09:10:00Z
Subject: Internal: approval request - Stellar Retail blended rates / step-ups

Team, looping you in to align before I send the formal amendment to Stellar. Key points: 
- Account: Stellar Retail (DEAL-7893) - renewal + expansion, baseline 25M -> 50M -> 75M step-ups.
- Proposed blended rates: 420 / 350 / 300 ($ per 1M tokens) across baseline/mid/expansion. Optional experimental route at 600 / 1M.
- Procurement target range: they asked for $250-350 avg; our mid/expansion tiers get them in-range.

Requests: 
1) Neha, can you confirm org-level approval on the 350 blended mid-tier? If we need to add an enterprise discount line-item, recommend we offer a one-time credit vs. lower run-rate.
2) Ben, can you draft the amendment table and include language for quarterly true-ups and an add-route clause?
3) David, please scrub for any SLA/latency exceptions given the multi-route timeline.

I've attached the draft pricing PDF and consumption estimate for reference. I plan to send to Alex and procurement once we align.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Procurement <procurement@stellar-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.j@stellar-retail.com>
Date: 2027-03-10T09:15:00Z
Subject: RE: Renewal + Expansion: pricing step-ups, blended rates, new model routes

Marissa, thanks for the proposal. Procurement reviewed the draft and attached a PO template and a few comments on invoicing cadence.

Attachments: po-draft-stellar.docx (DOCX)

A few notes: 
- The blended numbers look OK as an initial commercial; Procurement would like a firm first-year blended target no greater than $400 / 1M on average to present to finance. Can you confirm final blended ARR numbers with your amendment?
- Please include a clause for adding an experimental route (pricing + 30-day pilot terms).
- We'll prepare an initial PO once we receive the final amendment and confirmed invoice milestones.

Alex, we're ready to move when Redwood confirms final blended numbers and returns the amendment.

Regards,
Procurement Team
Stellar Retail
